answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a reputation kernel that decays without fresh verifiable work. Each agent holds an opal-like score whose pigment fades every epoch it contributes nothing provable - routing, validating, auditable compute. Clones start at zero, so mass-produced dormant identities gain nothing, and copying an established identity is worthless since its value evaporates without attestable labor. An attacker must run every fake agent productively forever, paying real compute exceeding any harvest, making attacks unprofitable.
